The '''Moog-3000 Death Synthesizer''',<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|7|State of the Arts}}</ref> also known simply as the '''Trade Federation cannon''',<ref name="Guide" /> was a model of double-barreled [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. They were mounted on tri-pods, and have a small targeting computer on top.<ref name="SW:OW" /> They have a long-range and possess strong firepower. They were placed throughout the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Guide" /> On [[Capture of Theed/Legends|multiple]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|occasions]] during the invasion, cannons were taken over by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and turned against the Trade Federation [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Moog-3000 Death Synthesizer was first mentioned in a preview for the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] in the "[[State of the Arts]]" department in [[Star Wars Gamer 7|''Star Wars Gamer'' 7]],<ref name="Gamer" /> shipped to subscribers on [[October 16]], 2001.<ref name="Fringe">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011018.html|text=Live on the Fringe: ''Gamer'' # 7}}</ref>
